status: Post-hoc diagnostics requested after all earlier study results were known. Rules recorded before computing these diagnostics; no new forecast model, retuning or independent validation.
dm: Mean QLIKE difference across all assets at each ordered origin. Bartlett HAC variance with 1/n autocovariances, no finite-sample multiplier; two-sided asymptotic normal p-values. Lags 4 primary and 9 sensitivity, in origin units, cover the four overlapping origin lags of the 21-session target. No automatic lag selection or small-sample h-based correction.
calibration: At each origin average Y/(h*s^2) and V/(h*s^2) over all assets. OLS normalized target on intercept and normalized forecast. Bartlett HAC sandwich with n/(n-2) multiplier. Joint Wald chi-square(2) test of intercept=0 and slope=1; report coefficients, robust SE, R2, p-values. Aggregation can hide asset-level miscalibration. The regression is diagnostic only and is never applied to forecasts.
multiplicity: Holm adjustment separately for the 18 DM comparisons and 27 calibration regressions at each lag choice. Lag 9 is sensitivity, not an additional opportunity to select significance. Adjustment does not correct prior researcher exposure or invalid marginal asymptotics.
degenerate: Undefined tests retained with NA p-values and explicit status; kept in multiplicity family size. Never substitute iid standard errors.
wins: Per asset and horizon, count paired origins with model-reference QLIKE < -1e-12; ties within 1e-12; losses otherwise. Separately count assets with lower full-period mean loss for panel/horizon bar chart. Descriptive dependent counts, not independent trials.
limitations: Only 186 dependent origins, noisy proxies, rolling parameter estimation and reused retrospective data. HAC and Wald asymptotic assumptions are not established by the model second-moment proposition. No causal, trading-profit or definitive superiority claims.
